findings.title: Debug mode enabled
findings.explanation: Debug output can expose stack traces, configuration data, and application internals.
findings.recommendation: Disable debug mode outside local development.

findings.title: Hard-coded secret
findings.explanation: A credential stored in source code can leak through repository access or version history.
findings.recommendation: Load secrets from an approved secret manager or protected environment variable.

findings.title: Weak Flask session cookie setting
findings.explanation: Weak cookie settings can make session theft or impersonation easier.
findings.recommendation: Enable Secure and HttpOnly session-cookie protections in production.

findings.title: Shell execution enabled
findings.explanation: Shell interpretation can enable command injection when input is attacker controlled.
findings.recommendation: Avoid shell=True and pass a validated argument list to subprocess.

findings.title: Unsafe dynamic code execution
findings.explanation: Dynamic execution may allow an attacker to alter program behavior.
findings.recommendation: Replace dynamic execution with explicit parsing and an allowlist of permitted operations.

findings.title: Insecure HTTP endpoint
findings.explanation: Unencrypted transport can expose or alter data in transit.
findings.recommendation: Use HTTPS and validate the remote certificate.
